test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following trophies is related to cricket?
solution:
Correct answer is __**Vijay Hazare Trophy.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vijay Hazare Trophy** is also popular as the **Ranji One Day Trophy.**
 
• It began in **2002-03** as a limited-overs cricket domestic competition involving state teams from the **Ranji Trophy plates.**
 
• The Vijay Hazare Trophy, named after the** legendary Indian cricketer**, has been won by 10 distinct teams so far with Tamil Nadu winning it the most number of times i.e. 5.
 
• Vijay Hazare was a popular Indian player related to the **sport of Cricket.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38e51a20dc34e138402ddfbcf61db6cde32baf8674977c3573b2270916771c46.png] 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The **Sultan Azlan Shah Cup** is an early international** men's hockey tournament **held in **Malaysia**.
 
• **Santosh Trophy** is an Indian football tournament in which the states of the country along with a few** government institutions participate**.
 
• The **Davis Cup** is the World Cup based on tennis.**​ **
